instanceForm.name: Name
instanceForm.platformLocked: The platform can't be changed afterwards: workflows already stored use the old one's format, and nothing could read them back.
instanceForm.platformHint: n8n (self-hosted) or Make (SaaS). This decides how workflow content is read — it is never guessed.
instanceForm.zoneHint: The one shown in the URL when you're logged in to Make. A token from one zone is rejected by the others with the same message as a missing permission: check this first if the connection fails.
instanceForm.keepToken: Leave empty to keep the current token.
instanceForm.makeTokenHint: Created in Make: profile → API access → Add token. Read access is enough: scenarios:read, teams:read, organizations:read.
instanceForm.baseUrlHint: The environment isn't tied to the instance: it is inferred per workflow (env:dev tag or " - DEV" suffix in the name).
instanceForm.keepKey: Leave empty to keep the current key.
instanceForm.apiKeyPlaceholder: Created in n8n: Settings → n8n API
instanceForm.teamHint: The numeric id of the team whose scenarios are listed — it's in the Make URL. Make refuses to list without a team or organization; the team is the more precise of the two.
instanceForm.orgHint: Only fill in to cover every team of an organization.
instanceForm.n8nAccountHint: The API key only opens the public API. Node descriptions — their parameters and allowed values — are served elsewhere, behind the browser session. With this account, checks target YOUR n8n version and your community nodes; without it, the platform falls back to a shared, more generic catalog. Leave empty to remove the account.
instanceForm.keepPassword: Leave empty to keep the current password.
instanceForm.passwordPlaceholder: The password of this n8n account
instanceForm.connectionOkN8n: Connection OK — {count, plural, one {# workflow} other {# workflows}} visible
instanceForm.connectionOkMake: Connection OK — {count, plural, one {# scenario} other {# scenarios}} visible

exportTargetForm.githubTokenHint: Fine-grained PAT with "Contents: Read and write" on the repo. Leave empty to use the server's GITHUB_TOKEN.
exportTargetForm.gdriveInfo: Google Drive: short-lived OAuth token (~1h) — suitable for one-off exports.
exportTargetForm.gdriveTokenHint: Leave empty to use the server's GDRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN.
exportTargetForm.name: Name
exportTargetForm.namePlaceholder: Filled in automatically when picking the repo

mappingForm.help: One row per identifier to switch (base, table, credential…). Leave unrelated envs empty — replacement happens between the values of the same row. The row name is only there to find your way: nothing in n8n compares against it, and it is filled in automatically if left empty.

envChain.title: Environments
envChain.idTooltip: Written into the {tag} tag and the name suffix ("X - STAGING").
envChain.afterTooltip: The env this one receives its promotions from. Two envs can branch off the same upstream: one staging per client, for instance.
envChain.monitoredTooltip: Its execution errors are reported: monitoring, Errors page, alerts. Elsewhere, an error is just the noise of work in progress.
envChain.canonicalTooltip: Its webhooks keep the bare path, with no env suffix: it's the URL external callers know.
envChain.duplicatedId: Two environments have the same id.
envChain.skipTitle: When a promotion skips a step
envChain.blockHint: Downstream envs: editable only through promotion.

communityDocs.fetched: {count, plural, one {# README read.} other {# READMEs read.}}
communityDocs.title: Community nodes
communityDocs.refreshAllTooltip: Re-reads each package's npm README, for the installed version.
communityDocs.textHint: Text takes precedence over the URL.

nodeCatalog.title: Node type catalog
nodeCatalog.updateTooltip: Downloads the shared catalog again if its upstream version changed. Nothing is downloaded if it hasn't.
nodeCatalog.upToDate: Catalog already up to date — nothing to download.
nodeCatalog.perInstanceTooltip: With an n8n account (on the instance page), the instance takes precedence over the shared catalog.
nodeCatalog.instanceReadPartial: {count} types read on {name}. Versioned schemas incomplete: {error}

discovery.title: Browse from n8n
discovery.unsupportedHint: Discovery covers: {providers}. Pick a supported provider in the form first.
discovery.noCredentials: No credential found in this instance's snapshotted workflows — sync the workflows first, or check the provider.
discovery.noCredentialsFor: No {provider} credential found in this instance's snapshotted workflows — sync the workflows first, or check the provider.
discovery.failedHint: The temporary workflow was kept in n8n, in the state where it crashed: its execution is below — delete it once you understand the problem.
discovery.dropConfirmHint: "{name}" will be deleted from the n8n instance. Irreversible.
discovery.noExecution: No execution — the failure is upstream (activation or unreachable webhook).
discovery.credentialsHint: Credentials collected from snapshotted workflows — the n8n API doesn't list them. Pick the one for each env: the name chosen here updates the label shown by the node after the switch.
discovery.howItWorks: A temporary "[NWM discovery]" workflow is created on the instance, called, then deleted — except on error, where it is kept so you can open it in n8n and understand.

disableEffects.monitoring: Execution error monitoring and heartbeats stop: no more alerts while the module stays off.
disableEffects.performance: Recording of execution durations and statuses stops; the Performance page and drift alerts are no longer fed.
disableEffects.notifier: No more alerts go out to Slack or webhooks (new problems, regressions, duration drifts, AI budget).
disableEffects.versioning: Workflow snapshots and GitHub / Google Drive export stop.
disableEffects.verifier: Structural verification, reliability checks and the AI logic review no longer run.
disableEffects.jsChecker: Code node analysis (syntax + AI review) stops.
disableEffects.fieldChecker: Checking of fields referenced in expressions stops.
disableEffects.remoteSchema: Column checks on remote tables (Airtable, NocoDB, Notion, Sheets, PostgreSQL) stop.
disableEffects.tester: Workflow tests and guided stubbing are no longer available.
disableEffects.envSwitcher: Resource switching between environments and cross-instance promotion stop.
disableEffects.organizer: The organization / naming plan (AI) and its application are no longer available.
disableEffects.docSchema: Mermaid diagram and AI summary generation stops.
disableEffects.depGraph: The workflow map and the External resources page disappear.
disableEffects.optimizer: Detection of naming issues / useless nodes and safe renaming stop.
disableEffects.modelAudit: Continuous LLM model audit (fit, lifecycle, oversizing) stops.
disableEffects.aiCost: LLM cost tracking stops; the AI costs page is no longer fed.
disableEffects.appLogs: The application logs page disappears (log capture, outside the module, continues).
disableEffects.resourceDiscovery: Discovery of real bases / tables stops.
disableEffects.configTransfer: Configuration export / import is no longer available.
disableEffects.dashboard: The aggregated home falls back to the shortcut grid.
disableEffects.assistantLearning: The assistant no longer learns from your corrections.
disableEffects.workflowChat: The AI assistant (chat, fixes, guided creation) is no longer available.
disableEffects.default: Its features and page disappear from the console.

syncModal.title: Sync — {name}
syncModal.readOnlyHint: Sync reads the n8n API read-only: no workflow is created, modified, activated, deactivated or executed on the instance.
syncModal.whatHappens: What happens on the platform side

read.title: Reading workflows from n8n
read.detail: A plain GET /workflows on the instance's n8n API, page by page.

mirror.title: Updating the local mirror
mirror.detail: Workflow name, active status, tags and JSON are stored in the platform database. Known workflows are updated, new ones are added.

version.title: New version for modified workflows
version.detail: If the content changed since the last sync, the versioning module creates a version. If an export target (GitHub / Google Drive) is enabled, that version is pushed there too.

syncModal.note: Note: the dependency graph and the workflow map don't update on their own — rebuild the graph from the Dependencies page after a sync.
syncModal.synced: {count, plural, one {# workflow synced} other {# workflows synced}}
syncModal.changed: {count, plural, one {# changed} other {# changed}} since the last sync: a new version was created for each.
syncModal.unchanged: No change detected: no new version created.

instanceShow.visible: {count, plural, one {# workflow visible} other {# workflows visible}} from the n8n API.
instanceShow.testHint: The test calls the n8n API read-only with the stored key. To test credentials before saving them, use the button in the edit form.
